duplicate_check.query:
select u.id as user_id, p.id as profile_id, p.name as profile_name,
u.raw_user_meta_data->>'name' as auth_display_name, p.role::text as profile_role,
nullif(btrim(u.email),'') is not null as email_present,
nullif(btrim(u.phone),'') is not null as auth_phone_present,
u.created_at,
exists(select 1 from public.staff_members s where s.user_id=u.id) as staff_membership_present,
exists(select 1 from public.staff_members s where s.user_id=u.id and s.active and 'finance'=any(s.perms)) as active_finance
from auth.users u left join public.profiles p on p.id=u.id
where lower(btrim(coalesce(p.name,'')))=lower('محاسب TALABOT')
or lower(btrim(coalesce(u.raw_user_meta_data->>'name','')))=lower('محاسب TALABOT');
duplicate_check.criteria: Exact trimmed case-insensitive approved name in profiles.name or auth user metadata name; not all possible email/phone identities

existing_registration.entry: Existing non-admin app signup; no direct auth-table insert or new auth mechanism
requires: password handled via secure auth flow, never GitHub/chat
existing_registration.staff_management: staff_set attaches permissions to an existing Auth user; does not create an Auth account

contact_requirement: A real email and phone assigned to this separate account are missing. No fictional contact, admin/demo/test account, password generation or live creation attempt used.
identity_policy: Display-name edits retain Auth UUID and attribution. Account handoff to a different person is not a rename; use separate identity/account and keep history tied to original UUID.
